method_definition: GPT-6 Astra with medium reasoning effort via Codex CLI generates Blender Python scene code; the GPT-6 Astra High prompt, output schema, fixed Blender construction, renderer, cameras, and metrics are reused byte-for-byte
proposed_method_definition: GPT-6 Astra generates Blender scene code; a fixed renderer produces Table-2 views
api_seed_note: Logical seeds index fresh independent Codex CLI sessions; no deterministic model seed is supported. Preserve returned code for deterministic local reconstruction. CLI JSONL does not expose a model snapshot.
notes: All outputs are isolated under gpt6_astra_medium paths; GPT-6 Astra High artifacts and frozen sources are not modified.
The method uses existing Codex login and local Blender/metric environments; no model weights or dependencies are downloaded.
Unstarted runs are missing data, not ITT failures. Only terminal preregistered quality failures receive ITT lower bounds.
IQA production batch size is 1, matching the validated GPT-6 Astra High protocol.

Before formal generation, later shared-workspace WorldScore/annotation edits were detected. Medium uses dedicated byte-identical copies whose SHA-256 values match the GPT-6 Astra High lock; the current shared files are not modified.
